name: fractonica-embed
description: Zero-dependency C library for embedded Fractonica displays: (1) og_build_glyph + og_glyph_rasterize render OctalGlyphs (radial core-ring + digit-arm glyphs) at a specified depth (3-8) and color directly into a caller-owned ARGB8888 pixel buffer, plus og_glyph_diff_rect for dirty-rect-only redraws; (2) saros_reading_at computes a Saros-eclipse-cycle phase-address (10-digit octal fraction between a solar Saros series' eclipses) from UTC time, using a compact flash-resident eclipse dataset. Pure ISO C99, no LVGL/Arduino/OS dependency -- works with any pixel buffer and any display driver you push it to yourself. An optional LVGL widget wrapper (lv_octal_glyph) is included separately in optional-lvgl-widget/ (not compiled by default -- see README) for projects that prefer LVGL's own display/flush pipeline over pushing pixels directly.
